subject: Compensation request: multi-hour latency impact on 2026-11-07
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@fecorp.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Elevated latency on 2026-11-07 — request for remediation credits

Hi Stephanie,

We experienced a multi-hour period of elevated inference latency on 2026-11-07 between ~02:10–05:40 PST that materially affected our checkout scoring pipeline. Our SLOs slipped by ~18% during that window and downstream retries doubled. I attached our internal timeline and representative traces (attachment: fe_corp_incident_postmortem.pdf).

Per our contract, we'd like to request a remediation credit for the impacted period and a one-month trial extension on the new dedicated capacity while we validate stability. Can you confirm next steps and provide a proposed credit amount?

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Head of Platform Reliability — FeCorp
olivia.park@fecorp.com

Attachment: fe_corp_incident_postmortem.pdf (PDF, 420KB)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Elevated latency on 2026-11-07 — request for remediation credits

Hi Olivia — thanks for the detailed timeline and traces. Very sorry for the disruption. I'm looping in Karthik (billing) and Marcus (account lead) so we can get a remediation proposal together quickly.

Immediate plan:
- I'll confirm the full affected token counts and the approximate cost exposure by EOD tomorrow.
- Karthik, can you prepare a proposed credit schedule (examples: % of monthly invoice or token-based credit) and include precedent cases?
- Marcus, FYI on FeCorp's ask for a one-month trial extension for dedicated capacity.

Olivia — would you be able to share the HubSpot deal ID for this contract (or let me know if it's sensitive)? That will speed approvals.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@fecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Proposed credit schedule for FeCorp latency incident

Team / Olivia — I pulled the usage for FeCorp and estimated the impact window token volume. Based on precedent we typically offer one of the following:

Option A — Invoice credit: 15% credit to the monthly invoice covering the affected billing period (fastest to issue).
Option B — Token credit: Equivalent token credit equal to 20% of estimated tokens processed during the incident window (useful if they prefer applied credit).
Option C — Small mixed package: 10% invoice credit + one-month trial extension on Dedicated capacity (trial valid for 30 days from issuance).

Attachment: proposed_credit_schedule.csv (CSV) contains line-by-line math and GL codes for finance.

Notes:
- Legal rarely wants a formal amendment for credits under $25k; finance can issue a credit memo once Marcus signs off.
- If the customer wants a multi-month remedy we escalate to the director (not ideal).

Marcus — requesting approval on the option to present. Olivia — do you have a preference between A/B/C?

Thanks,
Karthik
Billing & Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@fecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:36:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed credit schedule for FeCorp latency incident

Approve Option C with a small tweak: increase invoice credit portion to 15% (so 15% invoice credit + one-month Dedicated trial). I want to keep this package simple to close and avoid multi-step amendments.

Neha — please coordinate issuance of the credit memo and push to finance for posting. Karthik — once Neha confirms GL codes and the credit memo number, let's send Olivia the final credit memo and trial activation instructions.

Olivia — noted and approved from our side. We're committed to making up for the disruption and helping you validate the Dedicated capacity.

Marcus Lin
